meta.wikiDataVersionNote: Some wiki sections were last verified for game version 1.5; DLC coverage depends on the wiki.

grid.sizeConvention: size.w = width along the road (frontage), size.d = depth away from the road, in cells.
grid.rotation: 0 = front faces north (-y), 90 = east (+x), 180 = south (+y), 270 = west (-x).

rules.uniqueBuildingsOnce: Every asset with unique: true may be placed at most once.
rules.noOverlap: Footprints of buildings, roads and zones may not overlap.
rules.roadAccess: Every building with placement 'road' and every zone block must touch a road that has buildingAccess true.
rules.extensions: kind 'extension' must be placed touching its parent building instance; kind 'upgrade' has no footprint.
rules.highways: Highways do not give buildings or zones road access.
